messages:
maya: Quick QA — ran the link scan on /runtime/onboarding and got 2 image 404s and one internal shortlink 410. Pinged below owners? cc @ravi @ava

ravi: Thanks. Which images? I'll take the first (screenshot_3.png) — probably CDN path changed.

ava: I can claim the shortlink 410 (it's the old internal KB shortlink). I'll push a tiny PR to rehost and update the slug.

docbot: LinkScanner: 2 broken images, 1 shortlink flagged in docs runtime onboarding. More info: https://linkscanner.internal/reports/1757894321

maya: PRs: @ravi — can you add alt text in the PR? Also @jordan can you quick CR the rehost? low-risk.

ravi: On it. Creating branch docs/fix/onboard-imgs. Will drop a one-liner commit and push.

jordan: Happy to review after commit. ETA ~30m.

ava: PR pushed: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4821 — changed path + rehosted assets, updated shortlink to canonical slug. @maya please sanity-check.

maya: Looks good, left one nit re: alt text phrasing. If @jordan ok we can merge and cherry-pick to stable.

jordan: LGTM, merging after CI passes. :thumbsup:

ravi: CI flake on build step, rerunning.

docbot: CI: build passed on rerun (job 58).

maya: Thanks all. I'll follow up to assign ownership of that onboarding page to @ava in the doc-owners spreadsheet.
